main.description: A completion record for tracking when a user finished (or re-finished) a media item. Allows tracking re-reads, re-watches, etc.

mediaItemId.description: Reference to media_items table in Postgres.

completedAt.description: The date/time when the user completed this media item.

rating.description: Optional rating for this specific completion (0 to 5, half-star increments).

notes.description: Optional notes specific to this completion (e.g., 'Liked it even more the second time').

review.description: Optional reference (AT-URI) to an associated review record for this completion.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this completion record was created.
